riasec_fit_block.fit_interest: This work suits people who combine outgoing communication, decisiveness, and a results mindset. Budgets must be spent and measured, and managers must balance data with creative work and discuss both clearly.
riasec_fit_block.interest: This career develops fluency across data and creative work. You need to understand ROI and explain why customers should buy. It suits outgoing, decisive people who accept responsibility for results.
riasec_fit_block.riasec_short: Prefers Enterprising, Artistic, and Social work (E + A + S).

riasec_fit_block.fit_interest: 这行适合把「外向 + 主见 + 结果感」凑一块的人——预算要花也要算，数据和创意要平衡也要会聊。
riasec_fit_block.interest: 这行最练「数据和创意两头通」——既要看得懂 ROI，也要讲得出让人买单的理由。适合外向、有主见、愿对结果负责的人。
riasec_fit_block.riasec_short: 偏企业、艺术与社会（企业 E + 艺术 A + 社会 S）。

riasec_fit_block.fit_interest: This career combines steady hands, aesthetic judgment, and conversation. The haircut should look sharp and the interaction should feel natural.
riasec_fit_block.interest: This career develops tactile skill and visual judgment. Barbers need steady technique and the ability to read face shapes and clients. It suits people who enjoy hands-on work, can focus, and like conversation.
riasec_fit_block.riasec_short: Prefers hands-on, enterprising, and helping work (Realistic R + Enterprising E + Social S).

riasec_fit_block.fit_interest: 这行适合把「手稳 + 审美 + 会聊」凑一块的人——头要剪精神，人也要聊得来。
riasec_fit_block.interest: 这行最练「手感和眼力」——既要手法稳，也要读得懂脸型和客人；适合爱动手、坐得住、又愿意跟人聊的人。
riasec_fit_block.riasec_short: 偏好实操、开创、也助人（实际 R + 企业 E + 社会 S）。

riasec_fit_block.fit_interest: This work combines attention to detail + steady hands + an interest in equipment. A machine must be repaired and restored precisely, so technical skill and accuracy must stay in balance.
riasec_fit_block.interest: This field develops micrometer-level patience. Repairers must understand optical structures well enough to diagnose faults and have steady hands to return parts to their exact positions. It suits careful, patient people who accept responsibility for precision and enjoy turning faulty images into clear ones.
riasec_fit_block.riasec_short: Practical, investigative, and service-oriented (Realistic R + Investigative I + Social S).

riasec_fit_block.fit_interest: 这行适合把「细心 + 手稳 + 爱器材」凑一块的人——机器要修得也要修精，技术和精度要平衡也要会对。
riasec_fit_block.interest: 这行最练「 micron 级的耐心」——既要懂光学结构看得准病，也要有把零件对回原位的稳手。适合细心、坐得住、也愿意对精度负责的人，也享受从故障到清晰的过程。
riasec_fit_block.riasec_short: 偏好务实、钻研、也助人（务实 R + 钻研 I + 社会 S）。

riasec_fit_block.fit_interest: This career suits people who combine steadiness, efficiency, and quick reactions. The line must run smoothly, jams must be cleared, and unexpected events require composure.
riasec_fit_block.interest: This work develops practical feel and observation. Operators react quickly and identify problems by sound in noisy environments. It suits steady, efficient people who remain comfortable on the production floor.
riasec_fit_block.riasec_short: Realistic R + Conventional C + Enterprising E: practical, compliant, and collaborative.

breadcrumb.label: 输送机操作员与看护员

riasec_fit_block.fit_interest: 这行适合把「踏实 + 利索 + 反应快」凑一块的人——线要顺、卡要清，突发还要镇得住。
riasec_fit_block.interest: 这行最练「手感和眼力」——既要反应快，也要在嘈杂里听出毛病。适合踏实、手脚利索、也坐得住现场的人。
riasec_fit_block.riasec_short: 偏好务实、守规、也善协作（现实 R + 常规 C + 企业 E）。

riasec_fit_block.fit_interest: This occupation suits people who combine analytical thinking, hands-on skill, and coordination. Circuits must be stable and compact, specifications must be calculated, and designs must be tuned.
riasec_fit_block.interest: This occupation develops inventive solutions through logic. Engineers need a sound understanding of semiconductors and algorithms as well as the judgment to turn requirements into circuits. It suits people who enjoy hardware, can stay focused, negotiate over specifications, and value the full path from schematic to production.
riasec_fit_block.riasec_short: Prefers hands-on work, investigation, and practical business results (Realistic R + Investigative I + Enterprising E).

riasec_fit_block.fit_interest: 这行适合把「理性 + 动手 + 能扯皮」凑一块的人——电路要稳也要小，指标要算清也要会调。
riasec_fit_block.interest: 这行最练「逻辑里的巧思」——既要懂半导体与算法底层算得清，也要有把需求变成电路的工程审美。适合爱折腾硬件、坐得住、又愿意为指标扯皮的人，也享受从原理图到量产的全过程。
riasec_fit_block.riasec_short: 偏好实操、钻研、也务实（现实 R + 研究 I + 企业 E）。

riasec_fit_block.fit_interest: This career combines accountability, coordination, and composure. Disasters should create less confusion, and people must remain protected.
riasec_fit_block.interest: This work develops steadiness and a whole-system view. Directors understand emergency workflows and make decisions under pressure. It suits accountable coordinators who plan for worst-case conditions.
riasec_fit_block.riasec_short: Prefers enterprising, service-oriented, and structured work (Enterprising E + Social S + Conventional C).

riasec_fit_block.fit_interest: 这行适合把「担当 + 协调 + 稳」凑一块的人——灾要少乱，人也要兜得住。
riasec_fit_block.interest: 这行最练「稳和全局」——既要懂预案流程，也要在压力下拍板；适合有担当、善协调、又愿意为最坏情况做打算的人。
riasec_fit_block.riasec_short: 偏好开创、助人、也规矩（企业 E + 社会 S + 常规 C）。

riasec_fit_block.fit_interest: If you remain curious about production support work and accept judgment under moderate risk, this occupation is worth considering.
riasec_fit_block.interest: This field especially develops the ability to keep pace reliably. Workers need quick hands and awareness of what needs doing. It suits efficient people who can stand for long periods and tolerate repetition.
riasec_fit_block.riasec_short: Prefers hands-on work, follows procedures, and coordinates operations (Realistic R + Conventional C + Enterprising E).

riasec_fit_block.fit_interest: 如果你对Helpers Production Workers有持续好奇、又不排斥中风险下的判断，生产工人值得考虑。
riasec_fit_block.interest: 这行最练「跟节拍不掉链」——既要手快，也要眼里有活。适合利索、能站久、不嫌重复的人。
riasec_fit_block.riasec_short: 偏好动手操作、重规程、也讲调度（现实 R + 常规 C + 企业 E）。

breadcrumb.label: Inspectors, Testers, Sorters, Samplers, And Weighers

riasec_fit_block.fit_interest: This industry is suitable for people who "can't tolerate sand in their eyes" - stopping defective products will give you a greater sense of accomplishment than producing qualified products.
riasec_fit_block.interest: The value of this business lies in "checking": the batch of goods you release determines the reputation of the brand; the batch of defective products you block avoids a return. People who like to be more serious and enjoy "my standards are the standards" will find a sense of presence here.
riasec_fit_block.riasec_short: Realistic (R) + Conventional (C) + Investigative (I)

breadcrumb.label: 检查员、测试员、分拣员、采样员、称重员

riasec_fit_block.fit_interest: 这行适合「眼睛里容不下沙子」的人——把不合格品拦下来，比造出合格品更让你有成就感。
riasec_fit_block.interest: 这行的价值在于「把关」：你放行的一批货，决定了品牌的口碑；你拦下的一批次品，避免了一场退货。喜欢较真、享受「我的标准就是标准」的人，会在这里找到存在感。
riasec_fit_block.riasec_short: 实际型 R + 事务型 C + 研究型 I

riasec_fit_block.fit_interest: If you remain curious about motorcycle repair and are comfortable making judgments under moderate risk, this career is worth considering.
riasec_fit_block.interest: This field tests your persistence with machinery. It requires manual dexterity and patience when working around oil and water. It suits people who enjoy hands-on work, are fascinated by mechanical systems, and can focus for long periods.
riasec_fit_block.riasec_short: Prefers hands-on implementation, research and analysis, and clear standards (Realistic R + Investigative I + Conventional C).

riasec_fit_block.fit_interest: 如果你对Motorcycle Mechanics有持续好奇、又不排斥中风险下的判断，摩托车机械师值得考虑。
riasec_fit_block.interest: 这行最练「和机器死磕」——既要手巧，也要在油污水里不烦。适合爱动手、对机械有瘾、坐得住的人。
riasec_fit_block.riasec_short: 偏好动手实现、研究分析、也重规范（现实 R + 研究 I + 常规 C）。

riasec_fit_block.fit_interest: This career suits people who combine rigor, persistence, and accountability. Hazards must be stopped and corrected, requiring a balance of standards and field conditions and the ability to drive action.
riasec_fit_block.interest: This field develops a sense of safety through observation. Specialists must understand standards, identify hazards accurately, and build consensus around corrective action. It suits rigorous people who insist on details, accept responsibility for personal safety, and appreciate the full process from discovery to closure.
riasec_fit_block.riasec_short: Prefers investigative, practical, and orderly work (Investigative I + Realistic R + Conventional C).

riasec_fit_block.fit_interest: 这行适合把「严谨 + 较真 + 能扛事」凑一块的人——隐患要拦得下也要改得动，标准和现场要平衡也要会推。
riasec_fit_block.interest: 这行最练「眼里的安全感」——既要懂标准、看得准隐患，也要有把整改聊成共识的人情。适合严谨、爱较真、又愿意对人身负责的人，也享受从发现到闭环的全过程。
riasec_fit_block.riasec_short: 偏好探究、务实、有序（研究 I + 现实 R + 常规 C）。

riasec_fit_block.fit_interest: This career suits people who combine patience, empathy, and task analysis. Movements must be broken down, progress requires waiting, and people need warmth.
riasec_fit_block.interest: This field depends most on patience, empathy, and the ability to break down movements. A seemingly simple task such as tying shoes can require ten or twenty steps taught slowly. It suits thoughtful people who genuinely want to help and can tolerate slow progress.
riasec_fit_block.riasec_short: Prefers helping others, investigation, and hands-on work (Social S + Investigative I + Realistic R).

riasec_fit_block.fit_interest: 这行适合把「耐心 + 共情 + 会拆解」凑一块的人——动作要拆、进度要等、人心要暖。
riasec_fit_block.interest: 这行最吃「耐心 + 共情 + 会拆解动作」。一个看似简单的系鞋带，要拆成一二十个步骤慢慢教。适合心思细、真想帮人、又能扛慢进度的人。
riasec_fit_block.riasec_short: 偏好助人、也爱钻研与动手（社会 S + 研究 I + 现实 R）。

riasec_fit_block.fit_interest: This field suits people passionate about medicine who enjoy interacting with others. A patient's gratitude for a clear explanation offers the greatest sense of achievement.
riasec_fit_block.interest: The value of this field lies in trust. Patients share concerns about their bodies, and you help clarify problems and explain plans. People who enjoy interacting with others and are passionate about medicine find the tangible reality of front-line clinical care here.
riasec_fit_block.riasec_short: Social S + Investigative I + Conventional C

riasec_fit_block.fit_interest: 这行适合「对医学有热情、又愿意跟人打交道」的人——病人那句「谢谢你讲得这么清楚」，就是你最大的成就感。
riasec_fit_block.interest: 这行的价值在「被信任」：病人把身体的疑虑说给你听，你帮他把问题理清楚、把方案讲明白。喜欢跟人打交道、又对医学有热情的人，会在这里找到「临床一线」的实感。
riasec_fit_block.riasec_short: 社会型 S + 研究型 I + 事务型 C

riasec_fit_block.fit_interest: This field suits people who combine investigation + care + hands-on skill. Conditions must be understood, instruments held steadily, and responsibility balanced with patience and communication.
riasec_fit_block.interest: This field develops the ability to decide under uncertainty. Physicians combine symptoms and tests into judgments while absorbing patients' fear. It suits investigative, resilient people willing to invest for the long term and who value the moment of bringing someone back from danger.
riasec_fit_block.riasec_short: Investigative, caring, and hands-on (Investigative I + Social S + Realistic R).

riasec_fit_block.fit_interest: 这行适合把「探究 + 照护 + 动手」凑一块的人——病情要拼清、刀要握稳、责任和耐心要平衡也要会沟通。
riasec_fit_block.interest: 这行最练「在不确定里拍板」——要把症状和检查拼成判断，也要接住病人的恐惧。适合探究强、抗压、愿意长期投入的人，也享受把人从危险里拉回来的那一下。
riasec_fit_block.riasec_short: 偏好探究、照护、也动手（探究 I + 社会 S + 现实 R）。

riasec_fit_block.fit_interest: The most reassuring part is carrying a skill. Plastering work always exists, and skilled workers can find jobs anywhere. Seeing a wall you leveled shining after painting creates tangible confidence.
riasec_fit_block.interest: The most artisan-like quality in this work is tactile skill. Mortar consistency, trowel angle, and finishing pressure depend on accumulated feel. Experienced craftspeople produce visibly flatter walls from the same job, giving the trade tangible dignity.
riasec_fit_block.riasec_short: Realistic (R) + Conventional (C) + Investigative (I)

riasec_fit_block.fit_interest: 这行最踏实的是「手艺在身」：抹灰的活儿永远有人要，熟练工到哪都不愁没活干；看着自己抹平的墙面上漆后亮堂堂的，那种「这是我抹的」的底气很实在。
riasec_fit_block.interest: 这行最有手艺人气质的是「手感」：灰浆的稠度、抹子的角度、收面的力度，全靠日积月累的手感。同样的活，老师傅抹出来的墙平整度就是不一样，这种「手艺的尊严」很实在。
riasec_fit_block.riasec_short: 现实型 R + 常规型 C + 研究型 I

riasec_fit_block.fit_interest: This field suits people who combine a love of teaching, research ability, and commitment to education. Explain methods clearly, establish sound evidence, and develop capable people.
riasec_fit_block.interest: The dual track is the most demanding part of this work. Faculty must teach methods clearly, establish evidence through research, and accompany students into fieldwork. It suits people who love teaching, patiently conduct research, and support growth.
riasec_fit_block.riasec_short: They tend to be helpful, investigative, and enterprising (Social S + Investigative I + Enterprising E).

riasec_fit_block.fit_interest: 这行适合把「爱教书 + 能做研究 + 愿育人」凑一块的人——把方法讲透，把证据立住，把人带出来。
riasec_fit_block.interest: 这行最磨人的是「双线」——既要站好讲台把方法讲透，又要做研究把证据立住，还要带学生下田野。适合既爱教书、又能坐冷板凳做研究、还愿意陪人成长的人。
riasec_fit_block.riasec_short: 偏好助人服务、也愿钻研思考（社会 S + 研究 I + 企业 E）。

riasec_fit_block.fit_interest: This work suits people who combine attention to detail, dependability, and mobility. Data must be calculated clearly, roads inspected accurately, and coordination advanced effectively.
riasec_fit_block.interest: This field most strongly develops the ability to find balance within traffic flows. Technicians need some engineering and software knowledge and must visit sites to see real conditions. It suits dependable, detail-oriented people willing to travel.
riasec_fit_block.riasec_short: They prefer practical work, compliance, and investigation (Realistic R + Conventional C + Investigative I).

riasec_fit_block.fit_interest: 这行适合把「细致 + 踏实 + 能跑」凑一块的人——数据要算得清，路也要看得实，协调还要推得动。
riasec_fit_block.interest: 这行最练「在车流里找平衡」——既要懂点工程和软件，也要肯下现场看真实路况。适合踏实、细致、也愿意跑路的人。
riasec_fit_block.riasec_short: 偏好务实、守规、也钻研（现实 R + 常规 C + 研究 I）。

breadcrumb.label: Welding, Soldering, And Brazing Machine Setters, Operators, And Tenders

riasec_fit_block.fit_interest: This occupation suits people who love working with machines. Watching a robot produce clean welds using parameters you set offers a greater sense of control than manual welding.
riasec_fit_block.interest: The value of this occupation lies in human-machine collaboration. Robots weld quickly, but people must fixture parts, adjust parameters, and assess welds. Anyone who enjoys working with machines without spending the whole day at a desk can develop a grounded sense of technical mastery here.
riasec_fit_block.riasec_short: Realistic (R) + Conventional (C) + Enterprising (E)

breadcrumb.label: 机器铺设工、操作员、看护员

riasec_fit_block.fit_interest: 这行适合「跟机器打交道有瘾」的人——看着机器人按你调的参数焊出漂亮焊缝，比手工焊更有掌控感。
riasec_fit_block.interest: 这行的价值在于「人机配合」：机器人焊得快，但装夹、调参、看焊缝的判断得靠人。喜欢跟机器打交道、又不想只坐在办公桌前的人，会在这里找到踏实的技能感。
riasec_fit_block.riasec_short: 实际型 R + 事务型 C + 企业型 E
